authorization: One standard DFU detach, passive bootloader enumeration and descriptor reads, one four-byte compatibility query, no firmware download, followed by cold-power recovery and runtime verification.

recovery.method: User removed device power and cold-reconnected it.

notes: Two preliminary PyUSB scripts stopped before ctrl_transfer: one on a redundant string-descriptor read and one on usbfs EACCES.
A temporary user ACL was added only to /dev/bus/usb/003/004, the query ran once, and the ACL was removed before cold-power recovery.
The nonzero compatibility reply is a rejection/status result, not proof that a modified or stock package is accepted. Post-run REA analysis resolved it as TLSTATUS_MAGIC_MISMATCH.

Post-run REA analysis proved the stock updater first sends the image's 60-byte metadata header with vendor/interface control-OUT request 0x41/0xd1, then sends the 0xc1/0xd2 compatibility query. This authorized run intentionally omitted that write prerequisite, so status 0x62 cannot be treated as an image incompatibility verdict.
